One.Archive.exe native archive dependencies

7-Zip 26.04 (7z.dll, x64)
Source: https://www.7-zip.org/download.html
Binary: 7z2604-x64.exe
Installer SHA-256: D54BF805F9F3704D1E8DB2FA3498AE7EF2DF0312B40B558E7C71C734430A665D
7z.dll SHA-256: 899CD73D7FC60E1C1C35C7DE0F5BED3DC69BFE2CECBD48014D868A347970A0B1
License: vendor/archive/7zip/License.txt (LGPL, unRAR restriction, BSD)
Source archive: 7z2604-src.7z, SHA-256 6BCFD2679D178174DF06D09D50147DD7B5980D7BEAC896136689DFC9D51E0FD9
The original DLL is loaded only in the separate One.Archive.exe process.

minizip-ng 4.1.2
Source: https://github.com/zlib-ng/minizip-ng/releases/tag/4.1.2
Commit: 9826cbd4355af856b38bf8d863b29653b90c6b7f
License: vendor/archive/minizip-ng/LICENSE (zlib)
One local source modification: mz_os_win32.c size queries use shared read/write
access, matching the input stream, so concurrent readers cannot block one another.
One local Windows staging extension: mz_zip_writer_open_file_exclusive adds
MZ_OPEN_MODE_EXCLUSIVE. New disks use CREATE_NEW and deny write sharing rather
than truncating existing paths. The exclusive split stream allows at most 4095
data disks plus the terminal ZIP. Ordinary writer behavior remains unchanged;
the exclusive entry point reports unsupported on non-Windows platforms.
One local Windows provenance callback: mz_stream_os_set_created_cb observes
successful CREATE_NEW while the output is still empty. Recorded volume staging
flushes the real handle identity before allowing payload writes; callback errors
close the handle and return MZ_WRITE_ERROR without crossing C with an exception.
The callback is process-scoped (one native operation/writer) and unset on exit;
ordinary create/update operations do not install it.
One local LZMA adapter fix: allocation and decoder memory-limit errors preserve
MZ_MEM_ERROR through open/read/write/close instead of generic I/O/data errors.

zlib 1.3.1
Source: https://github.com/madler/zlib/releases/tag/v1.3.1
Commit: 51b7f2abdade71cd9bb0e7a373ef2610ec6f9daf
License: vendor/archive/zlib/LICENSE (zlib)

liblzma (XZ Utils) 5.8.2
Source: https://github.com/tukaani-project/xz/releases/tag/v5.8.2
Archive: xz-5.8.2.tar.gz
SHA-256: CE09C50A5962786B83E5DA389C90DD2C15ECD0980A258DD01F70F9E7CE58A8F1
License: vendor/archive/xz/COPYING.0BSD (0BSD)
The static liblzma target enables minizip LZMA/XZ methods. XZ tools are disabled;
GNU getopt sources are only present for upstream CMake configuration and are not
linked into One.Archive. See vendor/archive/xz/ONE-SOURCE.md.

zlib, minizip-ng and liblzma are built statically with the MSVC x64 runtime.
The archive helper is a separate process. Optional bzip2, PPMd and Zstd codecs
are not enabled. 7-Zip remains an independently loaded DLL.
